examples.text: The shocking truth about this event will change your mind forever.

flags.explanation: Uses emotionally charged language to provoke a reaction.
flags.suggested_rewrite: the available evidence about this event shows

examples.text: Experts say this is the only way to solve the problem.

flags.explanation: Cites unnamed experts, which weakens credibility.
flags.suggested_rewrite: A study by Dr. Smith suggests

examples.text: If we allow this, soon everything will fall apart.

flags.explanation: Presents a worst-case scenario as inevitable.
flags.suggested_rewrite: there may be consequences to consider
